messages:
Add JSON Patch application (RFC 6902)

Export applyPatch, JsonPatchError and the JsonPatchOperation type from
src/index.ts, with tests covering the RFC 6902 appendix A examples and
error cases, README documentation and ADR 0002 recording the design
decisions. Expose isArrayIndex from the JSON Pointer module for reuse.

Co-Authored-By: Claude Opus 5.5 <noreply@anthropic.com>
